registration: Pre-provisioned via OpenIddict manager and current DevicePollingWindow profile on each disposable database, as in public HTTPS integration tests. The browser and device then use public HTTPS routes.

limits: Local system Chromium. Test HTTPS certificate trusted only in the isolated browser profile. The witness receives a bearer access token and verifies durable human proof. It does not call a protected API with that token. The raw TRX is hashed and the identity-checked projection retained to avoid persisting any unsolicited framework diagnostics.
